set version [package require tcltest]
foreach relative {init.tcl tcltest/tcltest.tcl} {
    set original [file join $library $relative]
    set retained [file join /tmp/name-source-flow-isolated/production-03/capture-01/oracle-libraries-exact/84 [file tail $relative]]
    set input [open $original r]

    close $input
    close $output
    puts [list original $original retained $retained]
}
